acc.models_intro: Only M05 has evaluated scores. A blocked or research-only model shows its status and reason and no number.
acc.score: {metric}: {model} {model_value}, {baseline} {baseline_value}. Improvement {improvement}, 95% CI {low} to {high}. Over {months} months, {rows} district-months; test {from} to {to}. Vintage: {label}.
q.heading: Data quality and review queue
q.intro: Source health comes from the discovery records and state configs, not from live checks. A blocked or failed source is a data problem; it is never shown as a hazard.
q.owner_step: Owner account step; see the source record
q.queue_note: {model}: {label}. Of {required} flags needed, {adjudicated} are adjudicated, so precision is not measured.
q.queue_state: {state}: on {evaluated} evaluated cell-days, {flags} flags. S08 counts only; no rainfall value is shown.
q.extremes_body: Not shown on this page. A flagged value is neither a data error nor a hazard until a person adjudicates it. For warnings, use the official sources.
q.drift_body: {model} on {period}: {rows} district-months, MAE ratio {ratio} against persistence, improvement 95% CI {low} to {high}. Flag: {flag} ({label}).
q.drift_none: PSI and the 14-day labelled MAE ratio: unavailable, because no live issue-time predictions exist.
an.heading: Analysis reports
an.intro: Reports committed to the repository. A restricted source appears only as counts or derived indices; no raw S08 rainfall value is shown here.
an.restricted: Restricted licence: {sources}. Derived outputs only; public display waits for owner review (H11).
cmp.heading: State comparison
cmp.intro: States are compared only on the same geography level, an overlapping time span, the same unit and a stated normalisation, with coverage beside every figure. There is no single state ranking.
cmp.counts_note: Counts from each state's config, in config order. They describe catalogue coverage, not hazard or model performance. Models with state ALL (M16, M20) belong to no state.
cmp.row: Of {sources} sources, {enabled} are enabled (coverage {coverage}); {blocked} blocked. Of {models} state models, {models_blocked} are blocked.
cmp.r_none: At least one of the two states has no released metric.
cmp.r_span: The time spans do not overlap.
cmp.r_norm: No normalisation is stated (per capita, per area or against a climate reference).
offline.banner: Offline: showing a saved copy from {when}, {age} old. Anything about risk in it is not current. This is not an emergency service and nothing runs in the background to alert you.
offline.unknown: Offline: showing a saved copy of unknown date. Anything about risk in it is not current. This is not an emergency service.
